detailed_descriptions_html.en:
THE JOB

Objective: Hunt animals and meet quota.

Notice: Forest wildlife may act unpredictably. Proceed with caution, some creatures may be hostile.

WHAT YOU DO

You're a contract hunter.

Each night:

- Accept contract from pager
- Hunt specific animals as per contract
- Carry kills to truck
- Get paid

The animals are wrong.
Deer with eyes on same side of head. Rabbits that scream. Goats that speak Latin.

Carcass explodes when overstretched.

FEATURES

4-PLAYER COOP - Drop-in multiplayer || voice chat || Shared contract progress

HUNTING - One-shot kills || Limited ammo

CONTRACTS - 15 unique nights - Escalating difficulty - Specific animal requirements - Weight quotas

TRANSPORT - Drag your kills together. Stretch them too far, and they'll explode.

LOCATIONS - Pine Valley , Granger Farms, Blackmire Swamp

MULTIPLAYER

Works solo. Better with friends, up to 4 players.

Everyone spawns at camp. Everyone extracts together or dies trying.

Hunt. Extract. Repeat. Don't think about what the animals are saying.
